Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the second essay! The Bangladesh openers, Liton Das and Mohammad Naim walk out to the middle. Jacob Duffy to start off. Here we go...
... THE CHASE ...

Now, we have seen such totals being defended in recent times. New Zealand need to bowl accurately and try and pick up wickets on regular basis. Bangladesh know they need the one partnership and they’ll have the series in the bag. All to play for. Join us shortly.

The New Zealand batting was all about the one stand between Blundell and Nicholls. Yes, Young, Allen and Ravindra did get off to starts but they could not make it count. It was the 50-plus stand between numbers 6 and 7 which has kept the Kiwis in the game.

Bangladesh though will be disappointed. They had the Kiwis reeling at 62 for 5 but could not capitalise on the advantage. Their bowling wasn’t upto the mark in the last 10 overs. Also, they ended up giving away more than 45 in the last 5 overs which is not a good performance on this surface.

A really good recovery from the Kiwis and they have posted a total which one can be called a fighting one. Yes, the scoreboard reads 128 but on this wicket, if you bowl well, it is not going to be easy.
Length ball, on off stump. Tom Blundell shuffles across and scoops it behind square towards fine leg. They only get a single. New Zealand END WITH 128/5.
Tom Blundell has taken the DRS for an LBW decision. UltraEdge confirms that there's no bat involved. Ball Tracker shows that the ball pitched outside leg stump and Tom Blundell survives.

NOT OUT! The decision has been overturned. Fuller delivery, around leg stump and angling across. Tom Blundell looks to dig it out on the leg side but misses. Blundell gets rapped on the back leg and there is a huge appeal from the bowler. The umpire raises his finger, but Blundell reviews it straightaway. We can see that the ball pitches outside leg and Tom Blundell will continue to bat.
Fuller delivery, on off. Henry Nicholls drives it to long off for a run.

FOUR! STREAKY! Henry Nicholls and New Zealand will take it. Full and on leg stump. Henry Nicholls makes room to drive but gets an inside edge and the ball goes through his legs and into the fine leg fence.

DROPPED! Slower delivery, on middle. Blundell looks to hit it on the leg side but gets a leading edge. Shakib Al Hasan jumps to his left but fumbles an easy chance at backward point. The batters get one.
FOUR! Length ball, on the pads. Blundell shuffles a bit and helps it fine of the short fine leg fielder and into the boundary. Smart batting.
Fullish delivery, on middle. Blundell flicks it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Full and wide. Blundell looks to squeeze it out but misses.
NOT OUT! Full and straight. Blundell thumps it down the ground and races back for the second. The throw is a good one at the striker's end but Tom Blundell made it back in time.
Umpire review for a RUN OUT. The throw from the deep is at the keeper's end and it hits the stumps on the bounce. Tom Blundell was in comfortably and the decision on the big screen is NOT OUT.
WIDE! Straying down the leg side. Blundell looks to flick but misses. Wide called.
FOUR! Short ball on off and this time Blundell hammers it over the infield and into the mid-wicket fence.
Slower delivery, full and wide. Tom Blundell moves across the stumps and looks to scoop it over the keeper but misses.
Shortish delivery, pushed wider. Henry Nicholls toe-ends it to long off for a run.
Short and wide, cut away to deep point for a run. 13 off that over.
FOUR! Slower one, very full and on middle. Henry Nicholls stays back and times his straight drive to perfection. The ball races into the long on fence.
Length again, on the stumps. Henry Nicholls tucks it towards deep mid-wicket and races back for the second.
FOUR! Length ball, way outside off. Henry Nicholls waits for it and then frees his arms as he swats it over covers and into the fence.
Slower full toss, outside off. Blundell gets it off the toe end of the bat towards long on for a single.
Length ball, on middle. Henry Nicholls works it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Finally the boundary comes. Low full toss, on middle. Tom Blundell creams it past the bowler and into the fence. Top shot!
BEAUTY! Slower delivery, on middle and coming back in. Blundell steps out looking to go downtown but gets beaten comprehensively.
Full and around leg stump. Henry Nicholls looks to flick but gets an inside edge onto the pads. The batters take a quick single.
Slower one, full and wide. Henry Nicholls looks to ramp it over the keeper's head but misses.
Length ball, on middle. Henry Nicholls heaves it to deep mid-wicket and picks up a couple of runs.
Pitched up, on leg stump. Henry Nicholls pushes it back to the bowler.
Six singles from that over. Flatter one, on off and cut away behind point for one.
Fuller delivery, on off. Blundell drives it to long off for another single.
Short ball, on off and cut away to deep point for a run.
A touch shorter and Blundell hits it to wide long on for a run.
Tossed up, on middle. Henry Nicholls tucks it to deep mid-wicket for another single.
Flatter one, angled in on middle and leg. Blundell works it to deep mid-wicket for one.
Back of a length, on off. Blundell punches it off the back foot through covers for a single. They think about the second but decide against it.
Short of a good length, outside off. Henry Nicholls plays it over point and gets a single.
WIDE! Slower bumper, outside off. Henry Nicholls looks to upper cut it but misses. A wide is called by the square leg umpire.
Length ball, on the pads. Blundell flicks it to fine leg for a run.
Slower delivery, on a good length and around off. Blundell gets bamboozled by it.
Blundell gives the charge and Mustafizur Rahman bowls a short one on leg stump. The ball holds up in the pitch and Blundell misses the pull.
Length ball, on middle and leg. Henry Nicholls pushes it down to long on for one.
Mustafizur Rahman is back into the attack.
Floated up, on leg stump. Blundell gets beaten in flight and gets a leading edge, which falls short of the bowler.
Fuller one, on middle. Henry Nicholls sweeps it to deep square leg for a run.
Flatter delivery, on off. Henry Nicholls rocks back and punches it through covers for a run.
Deceives the batter. Tossed up, outside off. Henry Nicholls puts out a stride but gets deceived in flight. He does manage to block it out.
A touch shorter, on off. Blundell punches it off the back foot through covers for a run.
Arm-ball, angling in sharply. Well kept out by Blundell.
Slower delivery again, on the pads. Blundell flicks it to deep mid-wicket for another single.
Slower delivery, this time full and on off. Henry Nicholls drives it down the ground for one.
Another cutter, on middle and spinning in. Blundell flicks it to deep square leg for one.
A touch shorter, on off. Blundell punches it to deep point for a couple.
Slower delivery, around off. Blundell gets comprehensively beaten.
Length ball, on leg stump. Henry Nicholls pushes it to mid on for a run. Slight hesitation but the batters make it in safely.
Mohammad Saifuddin is back into the attack.
Quicker one, on off. Blundell keeps it out.
Flatter one and Henry Nicholls punches it off the back foot onto the off side for a run.
The arm ball this time, angled in on leg. Blundell gets it off the inside edge towards square leg. The batters take one.
Full again, and on middle. Henry Nicholls pushes it down to long on for another single.
Very full and on middle and leg. Blundell pushes it to long off for a run.
Short and wide. Henry Nicholls cuts it to deep point for a run.
Full, on off. Blundell keeps it out.
Who will come in next? Tom Blundell it is.

OUT! CAUGHT AND BOWLED! Mahedi Hasan has got the big fish. Tom Latham is in disbelief but he has to depart. Nicely flighted ball, on middle. Latham steps out and looks to turn it on the leg side but ends up getting a leading edge. The bowler takes a couple of steps to his left and pouches it easily. New Zealand are in deep trouble.
Quicker delivery, on the stumps. Latham blocks it out.
On the pads and flicked to deep square leg for a run.
Tossed up, on middle. Henry Nicholls keeps it out.
Flatter one, on off. Latham punches it off the back foot past point for a run.
Tossed up delivery, Latham pushes it on the off side for another single.
A touch shorter, on off. Henry Nicholls pushes it down to long off for a run.
Quicker one, on off stump. Kept out by Henry Nicholls.
Who will come in next? It's going to be Henry Nicholls.

OUT! BOWLED! Another batter has thrown away his wicket. Nicely flighted by Mahmudullah and on middle. Rachin Ravindra steps out and plays all around a straight ball as he looks to work it on the leg side. Ravindra pays the ultimate price as he gets beaten by the flight and the ball crashes into middle stump.
FOUR! Short and wide, punished by Rachin Ravindra. Ravindra goes back into his crease and cuts it through covers for a boundary.
Flatter delivery, on the stumps. Latham works it off the back foot on the leg side for a run.
Shorter one, on off. Latham rocks back and punches it past cover for a single.
A touch short and Ravindra tucks it to deep mid-wicket for one.
Flighted ball, on middle. Ravindra works it to wide long on for a couple.
Flatter one, on off. Cut away to point.
Tossed up, on the pads. Ravindra looks to sweep but misses.
Quicker one, on the stumps. Latham defends it out.
Tossed up, on middle. Ravindra pushes it to long on for a run.
Flatter one, angled in on middle and leg. Ravindra looks to flick but gets hit on the pads. An appeal but not given.
Tossed up, around off. Latham drives it through covers for one.
Flatter one, on off and blocked out by Latham.
BEAUTY! Tossed up, around off and this one spun away. Latham put out a stride and was lucky not to get an edge on it.
A touch short and wide. Ravindra cuts it through point for a run.
Tom Latham is in next.

Colin de Grandhomme has taken the DRS for an LBW decision. Just like the last review, everything goes in favour of the bowler and Colin de Grandhomme is a OUT for a duck and New Zealand lose another review.

OUT! LBW! Mohammad Saifuddin has trapped another New Zealand batter. The cutter just keeps doing the job for Bangladesh. It was served on a length and on middle. The ball nipped back in a bit and Colin de Grandhomme played all around it. He got hit on the back leg and the umpire once again raised his finger. De Grandhomme took the review but the Ball Tracker showed the ball to be hitting the top of the bails, i.e., umpire's call. Review not lost but wicket definitely lost.
Length ball, angled in on middle and leg. Colin de Grandhomme looks to tuck but misses and gets hit on the pads.
Colin de Grandhomme is the new man in.
Will Young has taken the DRS for an LBW decision. UltraEdge shows that there is no bat involved and Ball Tracker confirms that the ball was going on to hit the stumps.

OUT! LBW! Will Young has to depart. Length ball again, on off and it was the cutter this time. Young gets caught on the crease and plays a lazy shot. Young gets rapped on the pads and there is a huge appeal. The umpire takes no time to give it OUT. Will Young does take the review but it's three reds and he to to depart.
FOUR! Short again and on off stump. Young shuffles across and works it behind square on the leg side to the boundary.
Length again and this time Young blocks it out.
Length ball, slower and on off stump. Young tucks it to deep mis-wicket for two.
Mohammad Saifuddin is into the attack now.
A touch shorter and on middle. Young goes back into his crease and works it to deep square leg for a run. New Zealand are 40/1 at the end of the Powerplay.
Flatter one, on the pads. Ravindra tucks it behind square for a run.
Tossed up, on off. Young uses his feet to push it down to long off for a run.=.
Flighted delivery, on middle and kept out by Young.
On the pads, this is worked towards square leg for one.
Flatter one, skidding on. Young manages to work it towards long on for a single.
Flatter one, on off. Ravindra punches it off the back foot on the off side.
Tossed up, around off. Ravindra pushes it to cover.
FOUR! Ever so short and Rachin Ravindra latches onto it in a flash. He hops back and cuts it beautifully past point and into the fence.
Shortish ball, on middle. Young hops back and flicks it to deep square leg for one.
Flatter one, on middle and leg. Young tucks it past mid-wicket for a couple. There is a fumble in the deep but the batters settle for two.
A touch short and wide. Rachin Ravindra gives himself room and punches it towards wide long off. Shakib Al Hasan runs around and cuts it off using his foot. The batters do come back for the third.
Mahedi Hasan is back into the attack.
Tossed up, on off. Young pushes it to mid-off.
FOUR! Very full and on middle. Young sweeps it past square leg for another boundary.
Quicker one, darted in on middle and leg. Young flicks it to square leg.
Flatter one, on off. Young taps it to point.
FOUR! Up and over. Will Young uses his feet and gets to the pitch of the ball. Young whacks it over mid on and the ball races into the vacant boundary.
Tossed up, on leg stump. Ravindra works it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Excellent finish to the over from Mustafizur Rahman. Another slower ball, pitched up on off stump. Young manages to keep it out. A wicket maiden to start for Mustafizur Rahman.
Length ball, around off. Young taps it behind point.
An action replay of the previous delivery. This one pitches on leg stump again and Young gets hit on the glove while looking to defend.
Another off-pace delivery from Mustafizur Rahman. This one pitches around leg and moves away. Young looks to defend but misses and gets hit on the pads. Huge appeal from the bowler but turned down.
Back of a length, on off and angling away. Young looks to pull but gets beaten.
Who will come in next? Will Young it is.

OUT! CAUGHT! The Fizz has done the job straightaway. Mustafizur Rahman starts with the cutter, on off stump and this one holds in the surface. Finn Allen doesn't pick it up and gets caught on the crease. In the end he chips it straight to Mahmudullah at mid on. Allen will be disappointed with that.
Mustafizur Rahman comes into the attack.
Quicker one, darted in on off stump. Well kept out by Ravindra.
Tossed up, around off. Ravindra defends it well.
Shortish ball, on off. Allen pulls it towards mid-wicket, where the fielder makes a diving stop and keeps it to a single.
Tossed up, on middle. Blocked out by Allen.
FOUR! Short and wide, Allen takes full advantage of it. Allen rocks back and hits it through point for a boundary.
Flatter one, full on the pads. Allen tucks it to mid-wicket.
Who will bowl from the other end? It's going to be Nasum Ahmed.
Loopy ball, on middle. Allen come forward and pushes it to long on for one.
FOUR! Tossed up, on the pads. Allen gets down on one knee and slogs it behind square for another boundary.
Fuller one, on middle. Allen steps out again but pats it back to the bowler.
FOUR! Great use of the feet from Finn Allen. Flighted again and Allen plays it past mid off and into the fence for the first boundary of the day.
Flighted ball, on off. Ravindra steps forward and drives it to long off for a run.
Hasan starts with a tossed up delivery on off. Allen and New Zealand are away with a push down to long on.
We are ready for play. The umpires are out in the middle. Finn Allen and Rachin Ravindra are the openers for New Zealand. Mahedi Hasan to start with the ball.

Mahmudullah, the captain of Bangladesh says that, yes they are looking forward to the chase as the pitch looks better but he is still unsure on how it will behave. Adds that it's always difficult batting first on such a track and will be looking to restrict the opponent to a modest total. Ends by saying that there are no changes to their last match's playing XI.

Tom Latham, the Kiwi skipper says, that they will have a bat first and they took a learning from the second match and will keep improving. They will look to put on a competitive score and try to defend it. Also adds that the guys with the ball have done a wonderful job and will look to continue the same. Ends by saying that the wicket is tricky and they will look to improve upon it and there are three changes in the side.

PITCH REPORT - Tino Mawoyo is down with the pitch report. He says that the sun is shining and the pitch is the one used in the first match. There are cracks but they aren't visible due to the light grass cover. There will be variable bounce and the batsmen will have to adapt in order to have a flourish at the end.

Bangladesh (UNCHANGED XI) - Mohammad Naim, Liton Das, Shakib Al Hasan, Mushfiqur Rahim, Mahmudullah (C), Afif Hossain, Nurul Hasan (WK), Mahedi Hasan, Mohammad Saifuddin, Nasum Ahmed, Mustafizur Rahman.
New Zealand (Playing XI) - Finn Allen, Rachin Ravindra, Will Young, Tom Latham (C/WK), Colin de Grandhomme, Henry Nicholls, Tom Blundell, Cole McConchie, Scott Kuggeleijn, Ajaz Patel, Jacob Duffy.
TOSS - Up goes the coin and it lands in the favour of New Zealand. Tom Latham says that they will have a BAT first.

Hello and welcome to the 3rd T20I between Bangladesh and New Zealand. The Bangla Tigers are 2-0 up and will be looking to seal the series today itself. New Zealand, on the other hand, will be looking to get a win and keep the series alive. Their young side showed character in the last game and this match seems to be an exciting affair. The toss and team news coming up soon.
... Match day ...
